answer: Make every identity buy cover from a mutual insurance pool: a base premium of 8 POA per epoch, multiplied by the number of identities sharing its funding source, so a lone agent pays 8 while a cluster of five pays 40 each. A 40 POA bond, locked 30 days, backs each identity. Three random auditors check each identity's work; a failed audit pays a claim from the pool and slashes the bond. A sybil operator that tries to wander past the premium finds each extra sparrow it adds raises the price for the whole flock, while one honest agent climbs to the summit of full weight on a single flat premium.
